pictures.author: Orlovic (assumed by Commons)
pictures.observations: Entire960x706 front/side picture inspected. Four smooth round grey front shafts, pale leafy Corinthian capitals, open deep portico, raised limestone podium with centered stairs/solid cheeks, tall recessed rectangular cella door, layered entablature and plain triangular pediment with projecting cornice/dentil/modillion rhythm. Attached/neighboring civic architecture is distinct host context.

pictures.author: MumblerJamie
pictures.observations: Entire960x540 long-side picture inspected. Irregular pale rubble masonry with patchy repair areas, straight upper cornice, engaged corner anta and leafy capital, smooth grey side column, real open side portico and dark timber/coffer-like ceiling. No long-side windows. Roof tile edges visible above the cornice; hidden rear facade and exact stone inventory are not resolved.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Temple of Augustus in Pula: narrow rectangular rubble-stone cella, six smooth grey Corinthian columns (four front and two side), engaged antae, a true deep portico, recessed timber cella door, raised stone podium/centered stairs with cheeks, layered entablature, plain triangular pediment and projecting dentil/modillion cornices, simple tiled gable roof and open-column timber ceiling. Adjacent City Hall and independent urban buildings remain host context. No complete museum interior, copied readable inscription or narrative sculpture.
